decision.meaning: All automatable participant, workload, authorization, public ingress, and lifecycle gates passed. Manual browser review is now limited to visual and usability acceptance.

intel_llm_cpu_serving.journey: AnythingLLM deployment, document ingestion, retrieval, source-grounded model answer

intel_xeon6_agent_201.journey: MCP tools, agent workflow, structured solution output, real shared model inference

multi_agent_quickstart.journey: Three-agent workflow, MCP data retrieval, UI workflow, guardrails, semantic routing, runtime secret contract, Showroom pages, and namespace authorization

checks: workspace proxy and lazy CSS assets

red_green_findings.red: The deployed catalog rejected a clean Multi-Agent public order even though repository source and the retained workshop allowed public_code.
red_green_findings.root_cause: The control-plane image embedded a stale catalog.
red_green_findings.green: Rebuilt and deployed one backend digest to the API and lifecycle worker; a fresh public capacity preview and order then succeeded.

red_green_findings.red: The clean Multi-Agent reorder failed every seat with 'Workload revision must be an immutable 40-character Git SHA'.
red_green_findings.root_cause: Catalog v0.2.9 used a release tag where the GitOps contract requires a commit SHA.
red_green_findings.green: Pinned commit 100bcd4d4dd40e2ab74b59e984112c3d86fbac9b, added the 40-character provenance assertion, redeployed, and completed the disposable lifecycle proof.

red_green_findings.red: Two regression assertions still referenced superseded content and terminal image revisions.
red_green_findings.root_cause: Test/source version drift after live runtime repinning.
red_green_findings.green: Aligned assertions to the certified immutable revisions; the selected regression gate passed 245/245.

proof_strategy.TDD: Each discovered source/runtime defect is represented by a failing assertion before the green rerun.
proof_strategy.EDD: This manifest records immutable source and image revisions, live workshop IDs, per-lab functional results, public access behavior, reclaim timing, and residue counts.
proof_strategy.CDD: Catalog, workshop, public access, gateway, Showroom, GitOps, lifecycle queue, and cleanup contracts are included in the 245-test gate.
proof_strategy.BDD: Given a public workshop, participants can claim, resume, use the complete lab, remain seat-isolated, and lose access after bulk reclaim.
proof_strategy.CBT: Catalog, placement, workload, Showroom, terminal, workspace, identity, RBAC, public tunnel, and lifecycle were validated independently and together.
proof_strategy.red_green_matrix: Every defect listed in red_green_findings reached GREEN-local and GREEN-live before this gate was marked green.

remaining_gates.item: Manual visual and usability pass in a real browser for each retained lab.
remaining_gates.reason: Automation proves behavior and content, but cannot approve layout, instructional clarity, or presenter experience.

remaining_gates.item: Do not sync Application/launchpad-arena until the source branch is promoted.
remaining_gates.reason: The control-plane Application is Healthy but OutOfSync; syncing main now could revert the working pilot image and named-tunnel state.

remaining_gates.item: Run 25 simultaneous public code claims and three consecutive complete public certification runs.
remaining_gates.reason: All 75 participant workloads were functionally exercised, but public identity concurrency was sampled rather than burst-certified.

remaining_gates.item: Certify public OpenShift Console OIDC or keep it explicitly excluded.
remaining_gates.reason: The external participant Showroom intentionally removes the Console tab; namespace work is available through the authenticated terminal.

remaining_gates.item: Verify hard Keycloak account/session deletion after the final entitlement.
remaining_gates.reason: Application authorization, entitlement, role binding, and identity disablement are proven; identity-provider hard deletion is not yet evidenced.

remaining_gates.item: Move workshop images to a durable external registry or durable mirror.
remaining_gates.reason: The pilot remains dependent on the Arena-hosted internal registry.
The retained 75 seats run concurrently, but simultaneous provisioning of all three workshops is not certified as reliable on the current clusters.
